c.tagline: Canal city of classical gardens, Slender West Lake, and refined Huaiyang cuisine.

taxi.fareNote: Taxis are metered (flagfall around 9 CNY) but most locals book via DiDi and pay through Alipay or WeChat; carry some cash, as not all drivers accept foreign cards.

emergency.note: 110 reaches police, 120 the ambulance service, 119 fire and 122 traffic accidents.

avoid.reason: Watch pockets in holiday crowds along Dongguan Street and at Slender West Lake; otherwise usual city awareness.

hood_desc: The historic walled core in Guangling District, laced with canals and lanes around Dongguan Street, Ge Garden and He Garden — the best base for classical gardens, teahouses and old-town atmosphere.
The scenic quarter wrapping Slender West Lake and Shugang hill, with the Five-Pavilion Bridge, Daming Temple and leafy parkland; postcard Yangzhou and a calm, green place to stay.
The bustling downtown commercial hub around the Wenchang Pavilion, packed with malls, department stores, snack streets and nightlife — central and lively.
The modern western district of wide avenues, business hotels, offices and the railway station; a convenient, contemporary base a little out from the sights.
The regenerated Grand Canal waterfront around Sanwan Park, with riverside walks, museums and quieter modern residential blocks.

water.note: Drink bottled or boiled water; tap water is not potable.

transit.pay: Pay by QR code through Alipay or WeChat, or tap a Yangzhou Tong (扬州通) card; cash is accepted with exact change. Bus fares are around 1-2 CNY and the BRT runs a flat low fare.
transit.hours: Buses and BRT run roughly 6:00 AM to 9:30 PM; DiDi ride-hailing fills the late-night gap.
transit.note: Yangzhou has no metro; a Bus Rapid Transit system on dedicated lanes plus an extensive local bus network cover the city, and the compact old town is easily walked or cycled.

bus: Intercity coaches to Nanjing, Zhenjiang and Taizhou

car.idp: Required (foreign licenses not valid; a temporary Chinese permit is needed)

ferry: Grand Canal and Yangtze River crossings and sightseeing cruises

transit.m: Airport shuttle bus to the city center (~50 min)
Taxi to the city center (40-50 min, ~120 CNY)

tip.r: Tipping is not part of the culture and is not expected in restaurants or taxis.
